import 'dart:io';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/share.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  test('reads', () async {
    // Until the other test file has moved the process, when there is one
    // in this process.
    for (
      var waited = 0;
      waited < 40 && !Directory.current.path.endsWith('test');
      waited++
    ) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
    }
    expect(lookup(), isTrue);
  });
}
